chunks: From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Hammad ibn 'Isa, from Hareez, from the one who mentioned it, from one of the two (peace be upon them both)
regarding the words of God, Mighty and Majestic: 'He knows what every female bears, and that of which the wombs fall short of completion and that in which they increase'

He said: 'The decrease is every pregnancy which is less than nine months, and the increase is everything which exceeds nine months. So every time a woman sees pure blood during her pregnancy, she increases by the number of days during which she saw blood in her pregnancy.'

key_terms.أحدهما: One of the two — referring to either the 5th or 6th Imam
key_terms.الدم الخالص: Pure blood — unadulterated menstrual blood seen during pregnancy
key_terms.الغيض: The decrease/falling short — Quranic term explained as pregnancy under nine months
key_terms.تزداد: Increases — pregnancy extending beyond nine months

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic teaching on pregnancy duration and blood seen during pregnancy?
ai.summary: This hadith provides an authoritative interpretation of Quran 13:8 from one of the two Imams (al-Baqir or al-Sadiq). The term 'what the wombs fall short of' (غيض الأرحام) is explained as pregnancies lasting less than nine months, while 'what they increase' refers to pregnancies exceeding nine months. Additionally, the Imam clarifies that any pure blood a pregnant woman sees during her pregnancy extends her gestational period by an equal number of days. This teaching connects Quranic revelation to practical jurisprudential guidance on pregnancy duration, which affects rulings on waiting periods (iddah) and related family law.

en.hubeali:
From him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Hareyz, from the one who mentioned it, 
(It has been narrated) from one of the two (5<sup>th</sup> or 6<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>)
regarding the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [13:8] He Knows what every female bears, and that of which the wombs fall short of completion and that in which they increase.

Heasws said: ‘The ‘fall short’ is every pregnancy which is less than nine months, and what they increase is everything which increases upon nine months. So every pure blood which the woman sees during her pregnancy, so it has increased with a number of days which she has seen in her pregnancy from the blood’.
en.sarwar: 2. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Hammad ibn ‘Isa from Hariz from those whom he has mentioned who has said the following: “I once asked one of the two Imam, (abu Ja‘far or abu ‘Abd Allah), ‘Alayhim al-Salam,
about the words of Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, ‘He knows what every female bears and what the wombs decrease (spoil) and what they increase (dispose).’ [13:8]

He (the Imam) said, ‘Decrease’ is every pregnancy before nine months and ‘increase’ is what is more than nine months. Whenever a woman experiences pure blood discharge during her pregnancy a similar number of days are increased in the length of her pregnancy.’”
